Villager.trigger: a player has not spoken in the current round debate
Villager.rationale_short: Forces wolf to commit to a narrative instead of remaining a wildcard

Villager.trigger: one player has 3+ votes and 2+ other players are using identical wording in their reasoning
Villager.rationale_short: Prevents wolves from railroad-voting a villager using mirrored narratives

Seer.rationale_short: Creates a verified pool of trusted players to prevent friendly fire

Seer.trigger: round_num > 1 and a player has made a role claim that conflicts with previous results
Seer.rationale_short: Prioritizes confirming contradictory claims to expose wolves

Guard.rationale_short: Avoids wasting protection on wolves by not guessing early targets

Guard.trigger: a player has publicly claimed Seer or Witch
Guard.rationale_short: Ensures high-value utility roles survive to provide information

Witch.trigger: potion_poison == 1 and no player has made a contradictory role claim
Witch.rationale_short: Prevents catastrophic friendly fire caused by behavioral suspicion
Maximizes early game player count to maintain villager majority
